candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Order checkout trace shows OK at 70 ms, which does not reflect the payment span; no payment-level trace confirms where latency accrues.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces showing span durations and status for checkout calls
Payment dependency metrics (db pool waiters, dependency timeouts) to localize the latency source
candidates.statement: Payment service shows p95 latency of 1950 ms with elevated error rate 0.004 while gateway, order, and inventory stay at p95 80 ms and error rate 0.0012; order depends on payment per topology, so checkout degradation is bounded to payment downstream latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Single 5-minute window; payment internal cause (DB, external dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Only payment metrics deviate (p95 1950 ms, error rate 0.004) while gateway, order, and inventory are healthy; topology places payment downstream of order. Gateway deploy record alone cannot establish latency causation. Bounded candidate is downstream latency at payment; payment-level traces are still needed to localize the source.
